title: What stangent-fsd-lister returns (layer 5, D403, D404)
description: One answer per checklist item code didn't tick off: covered (the section and the FSD sentence that describes it, word for word, checked) or left-out (an undocumented finding code writes, at the item's own line). Code reads the answers one by one, so an odd one is not checked rather than a failed run.

checklist.description: D403: one answer per checklist item code didn't tick off.

id.description: The item's id, exactly as in the checklist (S03 or S03.012).

section.description: For covered: the FSD section that describes it, as in its heading's brackets. For left-out: the section of the screen it belongs to, or null.

fsdQuote.description: For covered: the FSD sentence that describes it, copied word for word from that section. For left-out: null.

note.description: For left-out: one sentence on what it is or does. Optional.

evidence.description: For left-out: more code that backs it (path:line); for a whole screen, the line that defines its route.
